title: Share lost since 1970: wetlands vs forests

source.name: Global Wetland Outlook / global forest-cover research (approximate, compiled)
source.publisher: Ramsar Convention on Wetlands; FAO forest-resource assessments

notes: Approximate; Ramsar's wetland-loss figure (~35% since 1970) is commonly compared against slower global net forest-cover decline over the same period (~10-15%, FAO), putting wetland loss at roughly 3x the forest rate.
